row: 玉山主峰海拔 3,952 公尺，是臺灣最高峰，也是北回歸線上的最高點。玉山國家公園 1985 年成立，橫跨南投、嘉義、高雄與花蓮，園內有三十多座超過三千公尺的山峰，是濁水溪、高屏溪與秀姑巒溪的發源地。

airspace.zh: 未查到此處專屬的公告內容；實際飛行前請用民航局「Drone Map」App 查詢並依規定申請。
airspace.en: No site-specific notice was found for this area; before any real flight, check the CAA "Drone Map" app and apply as required.

south.note: 3,844 m, a pinnacle of black shale (Wikidata Q16058613)

precipice.note: rock face with marine fossils, 1.2 km before Paiyun Lodge

tataka.note: visitor centre at about 2,600 m on Highway 21

batongguan.note: saddle on the historic trail (Wikidata Q10892426)

dongpu.note: Bunun village and hot spring on the old trail

title.en: Mount Niitaka and the Batongguan Trail

tagline.zh-Hant: 一座山的幾個名字，和橫越它的兩條古道
tagline.en: The several names of one mountain, and the two old roads that cross it

zh: 這是玉山，海拔3,952公尺，
臺灣的最高峰。
en: This is Yushan, 3,952 metres,
the highest mountain in Taiwan.

zh: 布農族稱它「東谷沙飛」，
鄒族的稱呼則音譯為「八通關」。
en: The Bunun call it Tongku Saveq;
the Tsou name is transcribed as Batongguan.

zh: 1875年，清朝開了一條橫越中央山脈的道路，
就以八通關為名。
en: In 1875 the Qing built a road across the Central Mountain Range,
and it took the name Batongguan.

zh: 吳光亮率隊從南投竹山開工，
同年11月完成，全長265公里。
en: Wu Guangliang began it at Zhushan in Nantou;
it was finished that November, 265 kilometres long.

zh: 路線經過東埔、越過大水窟，
終點是花蓮的玉里。
en: The route passed Dongpu and crossed Dashuiku
to end at Yuli in Hualien.

zh: 1891年，巡撫劉銘傳因維護費用太高，
放棄了東埔到玉里這一段。
en: In 1891 Governor Liu Mingchuan abandoned the section
from Dongpu to Yuli because of the cost of upkeep.

zh: 1857年，美國船長莫里森從海上望見這座山，
西方人因此叫它「摩里遜山」。
en: In 1857 the American captain W. Morrison sighted the peak from the sea,
and Westerners came to call it Mount Morrison.

zh: 日本人測出它比富士山還高176公尺，
把它命名為「新高山」。
en: The Japanese found it 176 metres higher than Mount Fuji
and named it Niitakayama, the "new high mountain".

zh: 1900年，人類學者鳥居龍藏與森丑之助
登上了玉山。
en: In 1900 the anthropologists Torii Ryūzō and Mori Ushinosuke
reached the summit.

zh: 1919到1921年，日本人另外修築八通關越嶺道路，
沿途派駐警察。
en: From 1919 to 1921 the Japanese built a new Batongguan trail
and stationed police along it.

zh: 1943年，北峰上的氣象站完工。
en: In 1943 the weather station on the North Peak was completed.

zh: 排雲山莊同樣始建於1943年，
2013年重建完成。
en: Paiyun Lodge also dates from 1943;
it was rebuilt in 2013.

zh: 1985年玉山國家公園成立，
清代古道在1987年列為古蹟。
en: Yushan National Park was created in 1985,
and the Qing trail became a protected monument in 1987.

zh: 東谷沙飛、摩里遜、新高山、玉山，
四個名字，一座山。
en: Tongku Saveq, Morrison, Niitaka, Yushan:
four names for one mountain.

tagline.zh-Hant: 從塔塔加到排雲山莊，再到主峰
tagline.en: From Tataka to Paiyun Lodge, and on to the main peak

zh: 塔塔加遊客中心海拔約兩千六百公尺，
在南投信義鄉的臺21線旁。
en: The Tataka Visitor Center stands at about 2,600 metres,
beside Highway 21 in Xinyi Township, Nantou.

zh: 登玉山主峰的步道從這一帶出發，
登山口海拔2,610公尺。
en: The trail to the main peak starts near here,
from a trailhead at 2,610 metres.

zh: 從登山口到排雲山莊，
要走八點五公里。
en: From the trailhead to Paiyun Lodge
is a walk of 8.5 kilometres.

zh: 抵達山莊前1.2公里，
步道經過「大峭壁」。
en: About 1.2 kilometres before the lodge,
the trail passes the Great Precipice.

zh: 排雲山莊海拔3,402公尺，
可以住大約116人。
en: Paiyun Lodge, at 3,402 metres,
sleeps about 116 people.

zh: 床位用抽籤分配，
中籤率曾經低到百分之一。
en: Beds are allocated by lottery;
the chance of winning has been as low as one per cent.

zh: 2016年起，山莊靠太陽能與鋰電池供電，
物資則由人力揹上山。
en: Since 2016 the lodge has run on solar power and lithium batteries,
and supplies are carried up on foot.

zh: 從山莊到主峰，
還有二點四公里。
en: From the lodge to the main peak
is another 2.4 kilometres.

zh: 1966年，山頂立了一尊于右任銅像，
1996年遭人鋸斷。
en: In 1966 a bronze statue of Yu Youren was set on the summit;
it was cut down in 1996.

zh: 玉山的圖像印在新臺幣一千元鈔票上。
en: Since 2005 Yushan has appeared
on the NT$1,000 banknote.

zh: 布農族住在公園邊緣的東埔與梅山，
約三百年前從平原遷入山區。
en: The Bunun live at Dongpu and Meishan on the edge of the park;
they moved into the mountains from the plains about 300 years ago.

zh: 東埔一帶，出土過史前的石器與陶器。
en: Prehistoric stone tools and pottery have been found around Dongpu.

zh: 文化部把玉山國家公園
列為臺灣的世界遺產潛力點。
en: Taiwan's Ministry of Culture lists Yushan National Park
as a potential World Heritage site.

zh: 2007年，鹿林天文臺發現的一顆小行星，
也以玉山命名。
en: An asteroid discovered by Lulin Observatory in 2007
was named Yushan as well.

tagline.zh-Hant: 落差三千六百公尺的國家公園裡，住著什麼
tagline.en: What lives in a national park with 3,600 metres of relief

zh: 玉山國家公園，
是臺灣面積最大、海拔最高的國家公園。
en: Yushan National Park
is Taiwan's largest and highest national park.

zh: 園區三分之二在海拔兩千公尺以上，
高低落差三千六百公尺。
en: Two-thirds of it lies above 2,000 metres,
and its relief spans 3,600 metres.

zh: 公園只占臺灣陸地約百分之三，
卻有一半的原生植物種類。
en: The park covers about 3 per cent of Taiwan's land
but holds half of its native plant species.

zh: 已經記錄到的植物，
en: The plants recorded so far
number 2,522 species.

zh: 隨著海拔升高，
植被依序分成六個帶。
en: As the land rises,
the vegetation changes through six zones.

zh: 最高的地方長著箭竹，
大約只到人的腰部。
en: At the highest elevations grows arrow bamboo,
reaching about waist height.

zh: 主峰一帶每年平均下雪二十四天，
十月初雪，到五月才完全融化。
en: Around the main peak it snows on about 24 days a year;
the first snow comes in October and is gone only by May.

zh: 這裡記錄到130種鳥、28種哺乳類
與186種蝴蝶。
en: Some 130 bird, 28 mammal
and 186 butterfly species have been recorded here.

zh: 大型哺乳類有臺灣黑熊、水鹿、
臺灣獼猴與長鬃山羊。
en: The larger mammals include the black bear, sambar deer,
Taiwan macaque and serow.

zh: 每年三到五月，
山谷裡有成群的蝴蝶通過。
en: From March to May,
processions of butterflies pass through the valleys.

zh: 這裡也是熊鷹在臺灣重要的繁殖地。
en: It is also an important nesting ground for the mountain hawk-eagle in Taiwan.

zh: 春天，杜鵑在山坡上盛開。
en: In spring, azaleas bloom across the slopes.

zh: 臺灣的特有種裡，
大約三分之一以玉山地區為棲地。
en: About one-third of Taiwan's endemic species
find habitat in the Yushan area.

zh: 一座山，從山腳到山頂裝下了好幾種氣候。
en: One mountain holds several climates between its foot and its summit.

title.en: The Highest Point on the Tropic of Cancer

tagline.zh-Hant: 板塊、冰河與三條大河的源頭
tagline.en: Plates, ice and the sources of three great rivers

zh: 玉山主峰3,952公尺，
東、南、西、北各有一座山峰圍著它。
en: The main peak of Yushan, 3,952 metres,
is ringed by East, South, West and North peaks.

zh: 東峰3,869公尺、北峰3,858公尺、
南峰3,844公尺、西峰3,467公尺。
en: East Peak 3,869 m, North Peak 3,858 m,
South Peak 3,844 m, West Peak 3,467 m.

zh: 南峰，是一座黑色頁岩構成的尖峰。
en: The South Peak is a sharp pinnacle of black shale.

zh: 臺灣位在歐亞板塊與菲律賓海板塊交界，
玉山是板塊擠壓抬升出來的。
en: Taiwan sits where the Eurasian and Philippine Sea plates meet;
Yushan was lifted by their collision.

zh: 大峭壁的岩層裡有古代海洋生物的化石：
約兩億五千萬年前，這裡是海底。
en: The Great Precipice holds fossils of ancient sea life:
about 250 million years ago this was sea floor.

zh: 玉山，是北回歸線上的最高點。
en: Yushan is the highest point on the Tropic of Cancer.

zh: 大約一萬七千年前，
冰帽曾經向下延伸到海拔兩千八百公尺。
en: About 17,000 years ago,
ice caps reached down to 2,800 metres.

zh: 主峰與八通關之間，
荖濃溪谷有一道斷層崖。
en: Between the main peak and Batongguan
a fault scarp runs through the Laonong valley.

zh: 濁水溪、高屏溪與秀姑巒溪，
都從這座國家公園發源。
en: The Zhuoshui, Gaoping and Xiuguluan rivers
all rise in this national park.

zh: 陳有蘭溪切過斷層，
向源侵蝕出金門峒斷崖。
en: The Chenyoulan River cuts through a fault,
eroding headward to form the Jinmentong Cliffs.

zh: 公園裡有三十多座山峰
超過三千公尺。
en: More than 30 peaks in the park
rise above 3,000 metres.

zh: 玉山年雨量約三千公釐，
八月最多，十二月最少。
en: Yushan receives about 3,000 millimetres of rain a year,
most in August and least in December.

zh: 東海岸外五十公里，
海水深度就超過四千公尺。
en: Fifty kilometres off the east coast,
the sea is already more than 4,000 metres deep.

zh: 從海底到近四千公尺的高空，
這段歷史都留在岩層裡。
en: From sea floor to almost 4,000 metres in the air:
the rock keeps the whole story.
